name: reagent
description: Reagent protocol language — compiler, reference runtimes, and tooling

scripts.build: npm run build:lang && npm run build:runtime
scripts.compile:examples: for f in examples/protocols/src/*.rg; do node lang/dist/cli.js compile "$f" "examples/out/$(basename "$f" .rg)"; done
scripts.test:m8a: npm run test:m8a:fp && npm run test:m8a:reg && npm run test:m8a:dec
scripts.test:m8b: npm run test:m8b:agent && npm run test:m8b:rec
scripts.test:ts: npm run test:ctrl && npm run test:lang && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:admin && npm run test:m8a && npm run test:m8c:lifecycle
scripts.test: npm run test:ts && npm run test:py && npm run test:py:coverage
scripts.validate:examples: for f in examples/protocols/src/*.rg; do node lang/dist/cli.js validate "$f"; done
